channel.title: Architectural Digest India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Architectural Digest India (architecturaldigest.in)

item.title: 10 easy-care hanging plants that make homes feel brighter while saving space
item.description: Check out these 10 varieties of hanging plants that introduce freshness and texture to your home without requiring much care and space.

item.title: Jatin Malik Couture’s New Delhi showroom is inspired by Shiva—but not the way you think
item.description: Drawing from Shiva’s philosophy rather than symbolism, Saachi Marwah choreographs curves, shadow, and the five elements into a deeply atmospheric interior for Jatin Malik Couture's third showroom in New Delhi.

item.title: Erika and Peter Born’s Mahalaxmi home tells the story of decades of collecting
item.description: Having spent many days when brunch stretched into dinner, interior architect Kunal Shah, a close friend of the bon vivant couple, shares his memories of Erika and Peter Born’s Mahalaxmi home.

item.title: 4 iconic bakeries in Pune that let you taste the city's history
item.description: From City Bakery to Ramsar, these bakeries in Pune reveal a heritage of architecture and culinary tradition, unpolished yet steadfast, offering a glimpse of a past that rises fresh every morning.

item.title: 9 architects in Kochi behind some of India’s most climate-conscious homes
item.description: From climate-responsive homes to craft-led interiors, these designers and architects in Kochi are building with care, context and a clear sense of responsibility.

item.title: 7 simple ways to protect your houseplants from pollution and dust
item.description: Practical maintenance habits that help houseplants breathe and grow better.

item.title: This courtyard home in Thiruvananthapuram is inspired by the colours of Chettinad
item.description: ARK Architecture Studio crafts Neelambari as a contemporary expression of Kerala and Chettinad sensibilities. Every space reflects the clients’ desire to return to the warmth and simplicity of their childhood homes.

item.title: 7 contemporary Indian homes built from the bones of ancestral residences
item.description: Keeping a legacy alive often means adapting some parts of it to modern times—here is how these homes in India do it.

item.title: 7 greenest homes in Kochi that embrace the simple luxuries of life
item.description: Local architecture and rich, verdurous landscapes define the aesthetics of these beautifully built homes in Kochi.

item.title: Inside the meditative Geoffrey Bawa Pavilion at the AD Design Show 2025
item.description: Bengaluru-based studio Phantom Hands and the Geoffrey Bawa Trust brought the Sri Lankan master’s Lunuganga estate to life at the 2025 edition of the AD Design Show in Mumbai.
